data.name: PlatAttack
data.detailed_description:
PlatAttack is a precision 3D platformer from Shushi Studios. Run clay courses against the clock, hunt medals, and race a ghost of your personal best. When a line is clean, the board knows. When it is not, you restart in a breath.

ONE JUMP. ONE CLOCK. NO ARGUMENTS.

Movement is the product. Jumps, landings, bumpers, mines, and fans all live on the same fixed-tick sim, so a replay is the same run — not a highlight reel.

FEATURES

• Precision platforming

Keyboard and controller. Coyote time, jump buffer, and a clock that starts and stops on the course — not on a loading screen.

• Medals that mean something

Author / Gold / Silver / Bronze on every official map. The ladder is public. You always know the next time to beat.

• Ghosts and replays

Every run records. Watch your PB. Race the transparent ghost of the time you already earned.

• Boards

Per-map best times and a global demo points total. Same-input runs stay honest because the sim version is on the replay.

• Map Builder

The same JSON the official maps use. Place blocks, roll gadgets, validate, save, playtest. Official and community maps share one format.

• Built for the grind

Restart is instant. Fail is cheap. The interesting part is the next attempt, not the cutscene.

WHAT'S IN THE DEMO

Ten official clay maps, medals, local ghosts, boards, and Map Builder. That is the Next Fest slice — the same physics the full game will ship with.

THE ROAD AHEAD

Season ladders, a longer campaign, and community maps on the same format are the plan after the demo. They are not in the demo download. Wishlist if you want the long game; play the demo if you want to know whether the jump is for you.

PlatAttack. Take the line. Beat the clock. Leave a ghost.

data.short_description: PlatAttack is a precision 3D platformer: clay worlds, tight jumps, medals, and a clock that never lies. Race your ghost, climb the boards, and build your own maps.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit, version 21H1 or later)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.5 GHz (Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 GPU with 1 GB VRAM (Intel HD 520 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4096 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit only. 1080p, Low graphics, 60 FPS. Internet required for leaderboards and Steam login. Offline play, local replays, ghosts, and Map Builder work without a connection.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core 3.0 GHz (Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent)
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 GPU with 2 GB VRAM (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4096 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: 1080p, High graphics, 60 FPS. Keyboard and controller.
